version.description:
Teak is a calm place to keep everything that inspires you. Save it in a tap, and find it again the moment you need it.

SAVE ANYTHING
• Notes, links, images, videos, voice memos, documents, color palettes and quotes
• Share from any app straight into Teak, without opening it
• Save the page you're reading with the Safari extension
• Record a voice memo or snap a photo right from the Add tab
• Ask Siri or Shortcuts to "Save to Teak"

TEAK DOES THE TIDYING
• Every card gets tags and a short summary, so you don't have to file anything
• Links come with their preview image and title
• Pull out a palette and copy any color in one tap

FIND IT IN SECONDS
• Search everything you've saved
• Type "image", "favorites" or "last week" and Teak turns it into a filter
• Filter by type, favorites or tag from the menu

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• A masonry grid that shows your ideas the way you saved them
• More columns and a details panel on iPad
• Light and dark mode, plus haptics where they help

YOURS, AND PRIVATE
• Your library is private to your account
• No ads, and your saves are never sold or shared
• Deleted cards wait in Trash for 30 days
• Delete your account any time from Settings

Your library stays in sync with Teak on the web, so your ideas are with you wherever you work.

Teak is for designers collecting references, creators keeping ideas in one place, and anyone who wants to remember what caught their eye.
version.promotionalText: Your library of ideas, now a native app for iPhone and iPad. Save from any app or from Safari in a tap, and find anything again in seconds.
version.whatsNew:
Teak is now a native app for iPhone and iPad.

• A faster grid that feels at home on iPhone and uses the bigger screen on iPad
• Save from any app with the share sheet, or from Safari with the new extension
• "Save to Teak" in Siri and Shortcuts
• Edit a card's text, notes and tags in one place
• Search filters like "image" or "last week" right in the search bar
